author: Xiaomi
description:
A favorite among Xiaomi car owners, the Xiaomi HyperOS-powered smart cabin.
The smart cabin boots fast, starts fast, and updates fast.
With #XiaomiSkyNomad, you can switch between scenarios with just one voice command.
Plus, new ecosystem products to choose, including Smart Watch Face 2, Magnetic Bump Stickers, and the In-Car Public Network Walkie-Talkie, open up even more possibilities for your journeys. Please note that these products are currently only available in the Chinese Mainland.
title: Meet the Xiaomi HyperOS-powered smart cabin
